carrier._: welded frame, 2 longitudinal RHS on the 2 chain strands, 2 locating bushes for the lift-and-locate units, PU bumpers front/rear; adapter plates: VC20 = 4 rubber-lined saddles for the tank feet, RB = 4 pins for the base frame (changeover 2 min, tool-free)
carrier._bumper: first design 10 mm gave 4.0 m/s2 > sliding limit 3.9 m/s2 (product slides on its pads when the carrier rolls into the one in front after an E-stop) -> 20 mm PU bumpers

conveyor.type: twin-strand accumulation roller chain 3/4 inch (12B class with free accumulation rollers)
conveyor._: accumulation chain: the carriers ride on free-turning rollers; a stopped carrier lets the chain run under it with a small back pressure (mu_acc); F_allow = allowable working pull per strand of a 3/4 inch accumulation chain [verify]

stopper._: damped pallet stopper class (hydraulic shock absorber) [verify]

ergo._elbow: standing elbow height incl. 25 mm shoes, DIN 33402-2 class values [verify]
ergo._lift: scissor lift table in a 250 mm pit at each ASSY spur: carrier top 100..800 mm (a floor-mounted table cannot go below ~350 mm; the VC20 top fittings need -90..135 mm)

feed.lifter: vacuum tank lifter on a jib crane, SWL 125 kg

test_dock: air outlet quick coupling DN15 (11 bar) to the test bench receiver / flow meter (ISO 1217)
400 V 16 A CEE plug for the motor (via the bench contactor and power meter)
noise: bench hood closes over the unit (ISO 2151)
carrier located by lift-and-locate pins +-0.5 mm so the couplings are made by a pneumatic docking slide

gates._: interlocked personnel gate sections (lift-up bridge) in the main line, one per long side: access to the spurs inside the loop + escape route; opening stops the upstream section (safety function -> F8, PL d); alternative: all spurs outward with a longer loop (~112 m) - decide in the final layout (F11/F12)
